Kai: Hey all, landing my first tiny PR (branch feat/kai/short-circuit). CI shows pre-commit lint and one mypy error. Also a bit fuzzy on commit message format and who to request for review — quick pointers? :wave:

devex-bot: Welcome! TL;DR: run `./scripts/setup`, `pre-commit run --all-files`, `poetry run ruff --fix .`, `poetry run mypy src/`. PR checklist: https://redwood.dev/devex/pr-checklist

Olivia: Nice! Branch naming looks good. We use `feat/` or `fix/` + ticket or short slug. Commit messages follow Conventional Commits, e.g. `feat(runtime): add short-circuit for routing` — keep the subject <=72 chars. If PR is >300 LOC add a short design note in the body.

Mira: Common CI failures: ruff/black formatting or mypy TypedDict shape mismatches. For mypy, often you need Optional[...] or to add `total=False` on TypedDicts. Paste the error here if you want me to look.

Kai: Thanks — quick Q: do we squash or keep history? Also number of approvals?

Jess: We prefer squash-and-merge for feature branches. Standard protection: 1 reviewer + passing CI. Sensitive areas (infra/, eng-runtime/) need 2 reviewers and passing integration tests. CODEOWNERS approvals are enforced.

ci-bot: CI | Build #4720 - Lint failed (ruff). Logs: https://ci.redwood/build/4720

Kai: Ran `ruff --fix` locally, fixed most. One mypy error remains; will DM @Mira for a quick 10-min pairing. Appreciate the quick responses :thumbsup:
